dedupe_keys.name: hpdmobile acquisition processing and validation tools

description: The HPDmobile developers publish Python tools for collecting and preparing residential occupancy observations. The repository separates acquisition setup for Raspberry Pi sensor hubs from image and audio processing, validation workflows, file management and shared helpers. Processing includes transformations intended to obscure identifying content while retaining signals useful for occupancy detection. Source access is public and free under GPL 3.0; the archived Zenodo release uses the broader label other-open. Coverage follows the six-home HPDmobile campaign, with acquisition routines reusable for compatible hardware. These tools can prepare observations for occupancy and building-control simulations using model-energyplus. A caveat is that hardware configuration and privacy-processing choices require local review. The presence of processing code does not establish that a new recording is anonymous. No collection service or processing workflow was run.
